original: 僕が君に優しくしようと思ったように、誰かに君が優しくされたなら、その人に優しさを返すのは当たり前だけど、それだけじゃなくて、君がその人にされたように、誰かに優しくしてあげなさい。僕はそれだけで十分だ。

en.text: If someone did something kind to you, the way I did for you, you have to be kind back. But not only that, you have to do something kind, in the same way, to someone else. That would be enough for me to be fulfilled.

original: 僕はテイルスと同じように、自己肯定感の問題を抱えてる気がするんだ。子供の頃に他の人と違うという理由でクラスメートに嫌な事をされた事とかもあって。でも、良くなろうと頑張ってる。それに、テイルスは人助けが好きで、優しくてフレンドリーなので、僕もそのようになりたいと思ってる。それが僕がいつもテイルスが好きで、共感する理由かもしれない。

en.text: I've noticed that just like Tails, I have self-esteem problems, partly because of my childhood, when my classmates treated me badly for being different, but I keep fighting anyways to be better. Plus, he likes helping and is sweet and friendly, same as I want to be. Maybe that's why I've always liked him so much and identify so much with him.

original: 優しくて思いやりのある方よ。

en.text: He's a kind and thoughtful man.

original: メアリーの外見じゃなくて優しさが好きだった。

en.text: I liked Mary, not for her looks, but for her kindness.

original: 島の人たちは、優しいです。

en.text: The islanders are nice.
The people on the island are kind.
The islanders are kind.
The islanders are friendly.
The people on the island are friendly.

original: 甘やかすだけが優しさじゃないんだぞ。

en.text: Indulgence alone is not kindness.

original: もっと、優しい言い方はできないのかしら？

en.text: I wonder if there's a kinder way to say it.
Isn't there a more gentle way of saying this?

original: もっと、優しい言い方はないのかしら？

en.text: Isn't there a more gentle way of saying this?

original: 誰にでも優しい人って、好きじゃないのよね。

en.text: I don't like people who are nice to everyone.

original: どうしてそんなに優しいの？

en.text: Why are you so kind to me?
Why are you so kind?

original: 彼女は、優しい心の持ち主なので、きっと喜んでくれると思う。

en.text: She has a kind heart, so I think it'll make her happy.

original: トムって、優しそう。

en.text: Tom seems kind.
